messages:
maya: FYI — Enterprise customer AcmeCorp tried to pay their Dedicated invoice with a corporate card and it was declined during checkout. They see a 3DS prompt but the bank returns a decline. Can payments triage?

olivia: Can you paste the payment log/receipt id and last4? also which invoice id and amount?

maya: Receipt id: pay_rcpt_01GFk2X0, invoice: INV-2026-0092, amount: $24,000. Last4: 4321. Customer says their card works elsewhere; decline happens after the 3DS flow.

payments-bot: (automated) Payment attempt logged — receipt=pay_rcpt_01GFk2X0, status=declined, decline_code=3ds_required, bank_response=MCC_BLOCKED, processor=stripe_us_eu

olivia: Interesting — decline_code=3ds_required usually means the issuer demanded 3DS and then rejected or the merchant MCC is blocked by corporate policy. Do we have the merchant_category in the event?

maya: Attached log snippet: ```
payment_event: {
  id: pay_rcpt_01GFk2X0,
  invoice: INV-2026-0092,
  amount: 2400000,
  currency: USD,
  last4: 4321,
  processor: stripe,
  decline: { code: "card_declined", decline_code: "3ds_required", bank_response: "MCC_NOT_ALLOWED", mcc: "7392" }
}
```

kevin: MCC 7392 is "Management consulting" according to lookup — some corporate cards block certain MCCs (software/services/consulting). If the customer's card admin blocks that MCC the bank will reject after auth/3DS.

jon: Confirmed: AcmeCorp's procurement (cc admin) has a spend policy blocking consulting and some software vendors. They paid other vendors earlier this week but those had different MCCs. They also have a PO on file for this invoice which we accepted in billing portal.

olivia: Two paths: 1) short-term: ask customer to pay with a different card (personal or other corporate card) or wire/ACH (we can provide wire instructions); 2) longer-term: request their card admin/issuer to allow MCC 7392 for this vendor or whitelist our merchant descriptor. For escalation we need merchant descriptor, MID, and the exact decline message to forward to the bank.

maya: I've DM'd Acme and asked them to try another card or arrange ACH. They asked if we can change anything on our end (e.g., set a different MCC).

kevin: We can't arbitrarily change MCC — it's set by the processor based on merchant profile. But we can check with payments ops if our descriptor maps to an alternate MCC (rare). I'll open a support ticket with Stripe to request a descriptor/MCC review.

olivia: Please include this in the Stripe ticket: receipt=pay_rcpt_01GFk2X0, invoice=INV-2026-0092, amount=2400000 (cents), card_last4=4321, decline_payload exactly as above, and request whether they can route with MCC 5734 (computer software) as an alternate. Also ask for any BIN-level workarounds.

jon: Customer is asking if a PO mismatch could cause this — they have PO on file but still tried to pay manually. Any chance PO metadata affects payment?

kevin: PO metadata is purely invoice-side bookkeeping and does not affect acquirer/issuer decisions. Declines from MCC are enforced by issuer policies at authorization/3DS time.

maya: Acme says their card admin is willing to open a case with the issuer but asked us for the exact bank decline text they should reference. Olivia, can you paste a suggested wording?

olivia: Suggest they reference: "Issuer declined the transaction after 3DS challenge with bank response 'MCC_NOT_ALLOWED' and decline_code '3ds_required' for merchant descriptor '<redwood-inference.com>' and MCC 7392. Please review corporate MCC allowlist for this card or temporarily authorize this transaction."

payments-bot: (automated) Stripe ticket created: ST-93281 (internal). Assigned to payments-ops.

kevin: I'll own the Stripe ticket and follow up. If Stripe can't remap MCC quickly, offer the customer wire/ACH and mark invoice INV-2026-0092 as pending-with-customer so we don't auto-cancel.

jon: I'll tell the customer to try a different card and also contact their issuer with that wording. I'll also confirm whether they want wire instructions.

maya: Thanks — tagging @olivia and @kevin for next steps. I'll update the thread when Acme responds. :thumbsup:

olivia: If they pick ACH, ask for payment ETA and send payment instructions template: ```
Bank: First National Bank
Account: Redwood Inference, LLC
Routing: 021000021
Acct: 123456789
Ref: INV-2026-0092 / AcmeCorp
```

kevin: Noted. Putting state: escalated -> payments-ops, severity=low (customer still has PO and can wire). Closing for now but will update ST-93281.

maya: Closing loop: Acme tried another corporate card and it succeeded. They kept original card blocked by policy. Customer asked us to document the decline reason for their admin. Thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
